args.summary: Deploy of v2.3.1 caused checkout-api to fail health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, across all regions. Post-rollback verification: service healthy in all regions, error rate recovered to 0.2%. Next steps: investigate the v2.3.1 changes before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health-check failures

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled all regions back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and recovery status. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains unhealthy in production history, so any future redeploy of that version would require change-manager approval under our policy.
